steps.title: Purge External Dependencies

steps.title: Design 3D Key Selector for Numbers
steps.description: Create a layered depth-inset asset for number keys simulating realistic tactile displacement when pressed.

steps.title: Design 3D Bevel Selector for Operators
steps.description: Construct high-contrast depth rendering layers for mathematical operator keys.

steps.title: Design 3D Control Selector for Functions
steps.description: Apply a recessed physical gradient style for secondary calculation control keys.

steps.title: Design 3D High-Contrast Equals Selector
steps.description: Define deep green neon tactile state indicators to give the confirmation button exceptional physical layout contrast.

steps.title: Design Sleek 3D Mini-Keys for Memory Rows
steps.description: Implement compact beveled card controls tailored for horizontal memory operations.

steps.title: Create Beveled 3D Core Loader Panel Background
steps.description: Build an outstanding deep card border layer list asset to act as the primary visual display for the startup loader overlay.

steps.title: Revamp Primary Application Layout
steps.description: Encapsulate existing calculator panels inside a FrameLayout, layering a physical 3D startup diagnostic card layout directly over the core view.

steps.title: Upgrade MainActivity Orchestration
steps.description: Inject interactive chiptune synthesizers on key actions, integrate startup screen timelines, and coordinate transition fade events.

steps.title: Validate Android Manifest Integrity
steps.description: Review application configuration metadata, confirm correct intent targets, and check standard hardware layout orientation bindings.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile the complete beveled layout, custom chiptune controllers, and startup transitions to guarantee full compilation compliance.
